topic_desc_basic: The New California Republic, commonly called the NCR, is a large republic expanding east from California. Its soldiers and officials seek to bring law and government to the Mojave, though many locals consider it overstretched and demanding.

Megaton is a fortified settlement in the Capital Wasteland built around an undetonated atomic bomb. Its walls were assembled from salvaged aircraft debris, and its residents rely on trade, local services, and one another for survival.
Deathclaws are large, powerful predators descended from creatures engineered before the Great War. They are fast, territorial, and widely feared throughout the wasteland.
